connector.name: Naming Signal
connector.registryDescription: Evidence-first naming: briefs, sprints, exact domain checks, finalist research. Read-only.
connector.summary: Hosted at namingsignal.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.namingsignal, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <NamingSignal user API key>. Create and revoke keys at https://namingsignal.com/developers. Every tool call is metered and rate limited through the account attached to the key.

env.name: NAMING_SIGNAL_API_KEY
env.description: NamingSignal user API key created at https://namingsignal.com/developers. Required for hosted tool calls.

env.name: NAMING_SIGNAL_API_URL
env.description: API origin. Defaults to https://namingsignal.com; set http://localhost:3000 for a local development server.
